title: Spec: silent observer detection heuristic in spec/06-security.md
description: Add section to spec/06-security.md defining the silent observer detection heuristic. Per-neighbor tracking: app_packets_seen (increments on any non-routing CoAP/UDP from this peer), vouch_count (number of peers that have vouched for this key), first_seen_ts (monotonic timestamp of first DIO/announce from this peer). Classification: if app_packets_seen==0 AND vouch_count==0 AND (now - first_seen_ts) > 3600s, classify as SILENT_OBSERVER. UI SHOULD display this classification with neutral language ('Silent observer'). Implementations MUST NOT use accusatory labels ('spy', 'NSA', etc.) in firmware. The classification is informational — it does not affect routing or packet handling. A silent observer still routes normally. Verify: markdown renders.
